out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. Employees are not routinely monitoring the temperatures of Time/Temperature Control for Safety foods during hot and cold holding.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. The EHS discussed the allergen awareness requirement with the PIC. The EHS discussed how important at proper hot and cold holding temperatures are to keep food safe.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. A bottle of water that one of food employees was drinking from was stored on a food storage shelf.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. The bottle was moved by the PIC during the inspection. Later, another bottle was observed in the same place, which was removed by the PIC. The PIC said he would discuss the drinking in the kitchen requirements with food employees.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There were no “employees must wash hands” signs in the restrooms used by employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. This is a repeat violation. Please provide the required signage by the follow-up scheduled for 8/24/2026.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: some deteriorated home standard colanders stored over the three compartment sink were visibly soiled and not clean.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC cleaned the colanders. RIGHT ANGLE CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/19/2026) Page 3 of 6

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: cut lettuce in the 2-door upright unit was 50º. According to the PIC, it was cut over 5 hours ago. The lettuce had not cooled to 41º in less than 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). The EHS discussed the cooling requirements with the PIC. The PIC discarded the lettuce during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pork ribs on the self service buffet were 125°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The EHS discussed that hot foods must be held at 135° in above. The ribs had been out of temperature for approximately two hours. The PIC was advised to discard the ribs by 3 PM. The EHS also discussed putting this and other foods on time as public health control.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: several foods on the customer self service buffet were not being held cold enough. Corn salsa was 59°. Pico de gallo was 59°. Cut watermelon was 68°. Cut honeydew was 68°. It was observed that the mechanically refrigerated cold rail units were either not working or not plugged in. Instead, ice was being used in an attempt to keep the foods cold, which was not working. The ice was not making sufficient contact with the food pans to keep the food cold. Additionally, cut watermelon was 44° in the deli case style display unit. Muffin batter was 57º in the refrigerator in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The EHS advised the PIC that cold foods must be kept 41°F or below even when on the salad bar. The EHS also discussed the possibility of putting these items on time as a public health control. The PIC will consider this. The out of temperature foods were discarded to correct. Cut watermelon must be maintained at 41°F and below. The PIC discarded the watermelon and muffin batter in the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: sausage gravy and biscuits with eggs cooked to order did not have a disclosure. Other items on the menu board had the necessary disclosure (and reminder) but this one, which was a poster separate from the menu board, did not.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. The PIC corrected this by putting a star/asterisk on this menu item during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed a bottle of cleaning chemical stored on the same shelf with single service utensils and equipment in the office area.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The EHS moved the cleaning chemical during the inspection to correct RIGHT ANGLE CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/19/2026) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines (cold medicine, aspirin, etc.) are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. These items were stored on shelving with food and equipment and over a food prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. The PIC moved the employee medicines during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. A can of Reel Kill ant and roach spray was observed in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. The PIC discarded the pesticide during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: lettuce cut 5 hours ago and placed in the upright refrigerator was covered, which did not allow it to cool within the 4 hours limit. Lettuce placed in preptop cooler was above the fill level and not likely to cool properly.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Correct cooling issues as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: several containers of spices, ingredients, and ingredient mixtures were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The PIC labeled these items during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Label Information
violations.observation: Insufficient information is provided on the label of the following food item(s) packaged in the food establishment: muffins, brownies and other baked goods offered for customer self service were not labeled as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. The EHS explained to the PIC that when the establishment packages foods for customer self service, the foods must have a label similar to any other commercial foods that are offered for customer self service. If the foods are packaged on site, but not offer for customer service service, they do not need to be labeled. The PIC said he would work on this.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed pickles and carrots, stored on the floor in the office area. Also observed tea, shortening and other foods stored on the floor in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Food employees were wearing watches, bracelets, and earrings while preparing foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who will discuss it with his staff. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths were being stored in a sanitizer bucket that was only water due to no chlorine in the storage bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The PIC corrected this by adding the appropriate amount of chlorine to the water, creating a sanitizing solution.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean cutting boards were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination. They were stored next to used cardboard egg carton inserts, which are not considered clean. Also observed a clean cutting board stored on the floor between the tall single door freezer in the wall in the corner of the cooking area. Observed a pair of tongs stored in a metal container on the side of the range. The metal container was not clean.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. The PIC moved the egg carton inserts during the inspection to correct. Discontinue storing food equipment on the floor. Move the cutting board as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months. The PIC moved the improperly stored tongs during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of spices and ingredients.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Discontinue reusing manufacturer containers. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: several home-standard plastic colanders stored in the kitchen were cracked, broken, and otherwise deteriorated.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. finished to have smooth welds and joints, and 5) accessible for cleaning and inspection. Cleaning and inspection shall be completed by one of the following methods: (a) without being disassembled, (b). by disassembling without the use of tools, or (c) by easy disassembling with the use of handheld tools. The EHS explained to the PIC that equipment in a food establishment is no longer cleanable if it’s cracked and broken and that home standard equipment should not be used. Only commercial equipment should be used. The PIC said he would discard the deteriorated colanders during the inspection. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: Observed a small wooden cutting board with a significant crack in it. The PIC reported that the cutting board is frequently used. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. The PIC was advised to discard the cutting board because it was no longer easily cleanable. The PIC discarded the cutting board during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: bare wood two by fours were being used to elevate the grease trap. Bare wood is not an approved material for non-food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. The EHS explained to the PIC that all surfaces in a permitted food establishment must be non-absorbent and easily cleanable, which bare wood is not, and that the wood could be painted or sealed to make it non-absorbent or easily cleanable. Remove the wood or seal it as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: observed several pieces of home standard plastic food storage containers such as Tupperware and Ziploc products and other brands, etc., being used in the establishment to store food.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. Food equipment used in a permitted food establishment should be durable and able to retain its characteristics. Equipment such as stainless steel, Cambro, or similar should be used instead of the type listed above. Please work on removing the home standard equipment and replacing it with approved equipment over the next six months.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The PIC reported that the floor drain under the three-compartment sink was draining slowly and overflowing if too much water was drained from compartments at one time.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. The drain is to be cleaned out this weekend. Correct as soon as possible or before the follow-up inspection on Monday, August 24, 2026. RIGHT ANGLE CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/19/2026) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line(s) of the food preparation sink and the sewer line. A hose is connected to the bottom of the drain basin at the three compartment sink and a second floor drain a few feet away, creating a direct connection between the floor drain and the basin. There was also a direct connection between the drainage piping and the wash basin of the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. This is scheduled to be corrected this weekend when the main 3-vat sink floor drain is snaked due to it draining slowly. An air gap or air break must also be installed on the wash basin of the three compartment sink. Correct both as soon as possible or within 3 days. Follow-up is required for this.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling panels were visibly soiled and in need of cleaning or replacement.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no such signage in the restrooms that employees use.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Please install signage in the restrooms that states employees must wash hands before returning to work. Correct within 90 days.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: a case of raw shell eggs was stored over potatoes and other produce in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the eggs to a lower shelf during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lettuce in the upright refrigerator was 48 (1 hour), provolone cheese on the prep unit was 55º (1 hour) and cooked potatoes in the upright refrigerator were 58 (<1 hour), cooked beans in the upright refrigerator were 48º (1.5 hours), and rice in the unit was 46º (1.5 hours).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All foods were moved to shallower pans and uncovered to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked beans, rice, potatoes, chicken salad, several packages of sliced cheeses, and other foods prepared on site were not being dated marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The PIC labeled all foods requiring date marking during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: chicken salad, cooked potatoes, black beans, and rice were not being cooled properly. They were stored covered in the upright refrigerator, and in tall, full containers.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The EHS discussed proper cooling procedures and techniques with the PIC. All foods were moved to shallower pans and stored uncovered to correct. CDI. RIGHT ANGLE CAFE (Inspection Date: 02/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

Correct within 90 days.
